name: Metaproterenol

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United Kingdom, first in 2009 — for heart harm

similar.name: Terbutaline
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm, effects on the body's chemistry and blood vessel problems

similar.name: Sotalol

similar.name: Dilevalol

summary: Metaproterenol was pulled from the market in the United Kingdom in 2009 because of harm to the heart [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low risk scores for both heart and liver harm [M]. Other medications that are chemically similar have had major warnings in the United States for heart harm, blood vessel issues, and body chemistry changes [4][5]. Additionally, another related drug was pulled from the global market due to liver harm [6].
